description: Write a draft public reply for each of up to 10 comments (comment_id from comments_to_answer), in the workspace's voice: US spelling, no dashes, 200 characters at most. The comments are read back from the network, so pass only their ids. Nothing is saved or sent: the person edits a draft and sends it with comment_reply_send or the Inbox's Send. A comment that needs a person (spam, abuse, a complaint, a link) or has no answer to give gets reply null and the reason. Claude writes the drafts within the plan's monthly allowance, at most 20 calls per workspace a day. An assistant that answers every comment at once drafts with comment_answers_draft instead.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: comment_replies_draft
title: Write answers to comments
